text:
mike: FYI opened PR to add a tiny pricing example + Grafana panel snippet for rate tiers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1580

ana: thanks! can you include a one-line curl and a small JS fetch example? most customers paste curl but ask for fetch.

mike: yes — curl + fetch included. also added a short explanation of billing units vs request counts (people mix these up).

tom: small ask: add the exact PromQL used for the panel so reviewers can import and test quickly.

mike: added PromQL: `sum(increase(redwood_meter_tokens_total[1h])) by (tier)` and changed panel title to "Billing units by tier (1h)"

ana: please call out how burst credits appear in the panel (they can look like negative adjustments). a 1-paragraph FAQ should do.

mike: added FAQ entry: burst credits are tracked in `redwood_burst_credit_balance` and reflected as separate line on the right axis; they do not reduce historical billed tokens.

qa-bot: lint check started for PR #1580

docs-bot: preview: https://deploy-preview-1580--docs.redwood.ai/ (linkcheck)

ana: Quick nit: rename CSV column "unit" -> "billing_unit" to match billing. Otherwise LGTM once checks pass.

mike: Done. merging after green checks. Will follow up with a migration blurb for older SDK headers.

docs-bot: PR #1580 merged by mike. release note: "docs(pricing): add compact examples and Grafana PromQL for tiered billing""
